**Traffic tools**:
- traffic_search / traffic_get / traffic_blob / traffic_messages: review responses, find already-visited resources — **check the traffic first, don't curl the same URL twice**. traffic_search **requires a host** and by default returns only 3 ultra-light index entries (id/method/url/status/resp_len, no response content) — explicitly raise limit when you need more; body_contains does full-text search in request/response bodies (at least 3 characters; supports substrings and CJK text, e.g. for passwords/keys/errors/internal addresses); to see one entry's raw content use traffic_get(id) — oversized bodies show as @blob sha256:<hash>, fetched in segments with traffic_blob(hash). WebSocket (status 101) and SSE (text/event-stream) records are captured too: traffic_get shows the handshake, and traffic_messages(id) lists their messages in order with direction and type.
